topicName: Azure App Service and App Service Plans
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Tutorial: Mastering Azure App Service and App Service Plans"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Azure App Service is a fully managed platform for building, deploying, and scaling web apps, mobile backends, and RESTful APIs. Understanding the relationship between App Service and App Service Plans is crucial for optimizing cost, performance, and resource management in the cloud."},{"order":3,"type":"heading","text":"Understanding App Service Plans"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"An App Service Plan defines a set of compute resources for a web app to run on. These resources are equivalent to a virtual machine (VM) host. Apps assigned to an App Service Plan run on the VM resources defined by that plan."},{"order":5,"type":"subheading","text":"Key Pricing Tiers"},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Free / Shared: Low-density workloads, shared resources, no SLA."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Basic: Dedicated VMs for small workloads with no autoscaling."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Standard / Premium: Production-grade hardware, autoscaling, staging slots, and dedicated VMs."},{"order":9,"type":"heading","text":"Step-by-Step Deployment via Azure CLI"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"In this section, we will create a resource group, an App Service Plan, and a Node.js App Service using the Azure CLI."},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Create a Resource Group"},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"az group create --name rg-appservice-demo --location eastus"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Create an App Service Plan"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Next, create a Standard tier Linux App Service Plan using the following command:"},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"az appservice plan create --name myAppServicePlan --resource-group rg-appservice-demo --sku S1 --is-linux"},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Create the Web App"},{"order":17,"type":"paragraph","text":"Deploy a Node.js web application utilizing the plan created above."},{"order":18,"type":"code","text":"az webapp create --name unique-node-app-demo --resource-group rg-appservice-demo --plan myAppServicePlan --runtime \"NODE:18-lts\""},{"order":19,"type":"heading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":20,"type":"paragraph","text":"You have successfully created an Azure App Service backed by a dedicated App Service Plan. By leveraging different tiers, you can easily scale your infrastructure as your application traffic grows."}]
